bounds_source_proof.notice: Exact source-byte identity establishes the recorded scalar limits, not independent proof that those bytes executed. Current hash matches do not establish historical execution provenance.

goal_stop_profile.empirical_reference_notice: Single-condition coast reference; not a robust stopping-distance guarantee.
goal_stop_profile.control_source: CARLA BasicAgent expert, not a learned model
goal_stop_profile.tail_policy: full brake only after measured stop and continuous dwell
goal_stop_profile.pilot_scope: Exact Town07 straight development only; 28.8 km/h nominal 30 km/h class.
goal_stop_profile.attempt_ownership: Two prospectively declared coast/feedback cases, one attempt per case; no automatic retry.
goal_stop_profile.full_future_xy_admission: Pending independent post-capture audit; scalar pilot completion is not dataset approval.
goal_stop_profile.steering_intervention_stage: After unchanged BasicAgent/PID first-proposal checks and emergency decision; before existing stopped-brake guard and ACK.
goal_stop_profile.setup_exclusivity: Reject existing vehicles, sensors, walkers, and walker controllers.
goal_stop_profile.event_abort: Abort at next observed collision/lane event snapshot; asynchronous delivery and physical actuation timing remain unproven.

hold_brake_experiment.factor: fixed inherited immediate normal hold; hold onset is not the v9 comparison factor
hold_brake_experiment.normal_control_stage: LocalPlanner normal pedals before the unchanged BasicAgent emergency decision
hold_brake_experiment.ramp_formula: min(1, (measured command-source time - first hold-source time + 0.05) / 0.5)

terminal_approach_experiment.factor: bounded normal low-speed terminal throttle feedback after the existing coast entry
terminal_approach_experiment.normal_control_stage: LocalPlanner normal pedals before the unchanged BasicAgent emergency decision

cases.world_restoration_claim: Collector cleanup receipt only; no independent eleven-field restoration proof.

physics_substeps.interpretation: A maximum numerical setting with readback, not measured internal integration intervals or physical accuracy.

transport.notice: PASS means coherent recorded command acceptance and frame/state evidence only; it does not prove physical actuator timing, driving quality, visual quality or dataset admission.

hold_and_steering_policy.interpretation: Measured source time plus 50 ms defines the normal request, not physical substep onset. Float32 storage is separately reconstructed; no tick rounding or label change.

measured_future.interpretation: Necessary discrete XY/speed bounds, not a sufficient feasibility proof; yaw is a proxy. Overlapping horizon windows are not independent events. Original warmup anchors remain included, tail anchors remain context-only; unavailable futures are not extrapolated.

curvature_incidence.interpretation: Grouping and boundary overlap are observational, not a physical-cause assignment. All original flags remain failures.

hold_motion.interpretation: All native intervals through original dwell and tail are included. Actor signed vector integration is trapezoidal observed-state analysis, not substep ground truth; virtual base and actor positions are distinct.

terminal_motion.interpretation: Distance is measured on actual following native intervals, not attributed to throttle or substituted for raw labels.

limitations: All original full-future gates and failed rows are retained; no training or vehicle approval.
Maximum substep settings do not prove actual internal timesteps or physical accuracy. Normal immediate hold, emergency authority and zero steering remain unchanged.
Both arms are fresh v9 trials with fixed reference_10ms, immediate hold and zero low-speed steering; only bounded terminal throttle feedback differs.
The pre-feedback prefix comparison excludes only the first treated source's next command. Absolute clocks/IDs are excluded without retiming.
Count/rate decreases can coexist with a worse maximum. One fixed Town07 route/seed/weather pair cannot establish repeatability, broad robustness or unique physical cause.
Readiness is observed, not reserved; the wrapper's admission remains authoritative.
Recorded six-field settings and cleanup receipts are not an independent eleven-field restoration proof.
